issues.issue: N field lists only PBO=98/20mg=100/50mg=101 (no 5 mg arm), but the result field reports a 5 mg/day dose (p=0.885), so the arms are internally inconsistent and the 5 mg N is missing.
The cited % reduction for the 5 mg arm '-0.9 (-13.9, 106)' contains an apparent OCR error in the CI upper bound (106), though it is not surfaced in the result text.

AE rate 'nausea/vomiting symptoms (5% vs 3%)' is supported, but the value is labeled as occurring 'at doses >=50 mg/day'; the >=50 mg/day qualifier is not present in any citation and appears asserted beyond the quotes.
Automated flag on '12' (12-week) is a false positive; '12 weeks' is supported by the n-field citation ('Treatment period= 12 weeks').
Automated flags on 100/50/20 are false positives; these are doses (excluded) whose p-values and CIs are supported by the cited table.
Automated flags on 100/200/50 are false positives; these are dose labels whose associated efficacy figures (22.8, 23.2, responder rates 38.9/37.8/21.6) are supported by citations.
Automated flag on '2' (Study 2 label) is a false positive; it is a study-numbering identifier, not an efficacy/safety number.
Automated flag on '3' (three trials) is a false positive; supported by citation 'three adequate and well-controlled studies (studies 1252, 1253, and 1358)'.
Automated flag on '50' is a false positive in the sense of being a dose threshold, but see the medium issue: the >=50 mg/day qualifier itself is uncited.
